citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Covers M7+ events through 2015 including 2001-01-01 M7.5 Mindanao (usp000a70h), 2002-03-05 M7.5 Cotabato (usp000azqw), 2006-12-26 M7.1 Pingtung (usp000f114), 2012-08-31 M7.6 Samar/Philippine Trench (usp000jr83), and 2013-10-15 M7.1 Bohol (usb000kdb4).
limitations_and_caveats: Scope limited to M7+ through 2015; excludes post-2015 M7+ events (us6000i5rd, us7000lff4, us7000m9g4, us6000rfwz).

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Subplate overlays across Bicol (9), Mindanao (9), East Luzon (7), Philippine (5), and West Luzon (3), plus nearest mapped boundary distances.
limitations_and_caveats: Hasterok Philippine polygon captures two distant Mariana-Yap junction events (usp000g5yf, usp000hj2j) and East Luzon polygon extends north into eastern Taiwan collision zone.

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: Plate boundary discretization separating Philippine Sea plate from Sunda/Eurasia across Manila, Philippine, and Cotabato trenches.
limitations_and_caveats: Does not resolve internal Philippine Mobile Belt fault blocks or 3D slab geometry.

citation: Faccenna et al. (2018), Dynamics of the Ryukyu/Izu-Bonin-Marianas double subduction system, Tectonophysics 746, 229-238
evidence_used: Regional tectonic context for Taiwan arc-continent collision and northern Luzon Strait junction with Ryukyu/Manila trenches.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional geodynamic synthesis only; individual event mechanisms require ComCat detail product verification.
